game.title: Atya Patya
game.description: A traditional tag game described as a 'game of feints' played on a court with nine trenches. Attacking players score points by crossing trenches without being tagged by defenders.
howToPlay: Step 1: Court features nine parallel trenches extending from a central trench.
Step 2: Attacking team sends players to cross trenches.
Step 3: Defenders in trenches try to tag attackers.
Step 4: Points awarded for each trench crossed without being tagged.
Step 5: Players use feints and quick movements to evade tags.
Step 6: Game consists of 4 innings of 7 minutes each.
Step 7: Each team has two innings to score.
Step 8: Team with highest total points wins.
Step 9: Requires agility, strategy, and teamwork.
Step 10: Described as 'militant chase' for its intensity.
